title: I'm looking for basic characters for my game

posts.author: LeRoiManlo
posts.body: Hi, I'm looking for character bases to create for my game. Are there any free ones that offer neutral sprites on which I could redraw to create my own characters please. I think the ideal would be in 48x96 format please.

posts.author: Zia_
posts.body:
48x96 is quite large, therefore detailed and a lot of work. So it's an unusual size to find it offered for free.
Still, you should scan through itch.io, there are some free assets.
Some examples. They don't match your specific size, but you could edit them.
Girl Knight Character Asset by JumpButton
Hand drawn animated character made in pixel art
jumpbutton.itch.io
Basic Character-Female Pack  64  Ver Free by Angeler1234
Basic sprite animation in 4 directions , plump woman with breasts shaking!!
angeler1234.itch.io
Animated Pixel Adventurer by rvros
Free 2D character sprite for your games.
rvros.itch.io
FREE Pixel Art Male and Female Character by GandalfHardcore
Fully Animated and FREE Pixel Art Female and Male characters for your game!
gandalfhardcore.itch.io
